name: plugins-radar
description: Insights for plugin makers about the ChatGPT plugin directory

interface.longDescription:
Plugins Radar helps plugin makers understand how plugins appear in the ChatGPT plugin directory. Ask how a plugin shows up in directory search, whether it appears on the Featured page or a home page section, which similar plugins show up for the same searches, and how complete its listing is, with a practical tip to improve it. You can also ask what's new in the directory.

Try: "How is Canva doing in the plugin directory?", "Which plugins show up for car rental?", "What's featured right now?", "Top travel plugins", "What's new in the plugin directory this week?"

Answers link to more detail on pluginsradar.com. Plugins Radar is an independent tool, not affiliated with OpenAI, and uses only information the directory shows publicly.
defaultPrompt: How is Canva doing in the plugin directory?
Which plugins show up for car rental?
What's featured in the plugin directory right now?
